notes.zh-CN: 修复侧栏项目标题的双箭头按钮。点击收起会话列表时保留项目文件夹的展开状态，再次点击可恢复列表。macOS universal 为开发签名且未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Fixes the double-chevron button in sidebar project headers. It collapses the session list while keeping the project folder open. Click again to restore the list. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
